note: Sizes are the STL bounding boxes in millimetres (width x depth x height). tests/test_quick.py checks them against the files.

items.name: One-post holder
items.description: Holds one label clip. Mount it on an AMS unit, dryer or shelf edge.
items.pairs: Used on: Bambu Lab AMS HT (one per unit).

items.name: Two-post holder
items.description: Holds two label clips side by side.
items.pairs: Used on: Creality SpacePi X4 (two per unit).

items.name: Four-post holder
items.description: Holds four label clips side by side. At 320 mm long it needs a large print bed; see the split version for smaller printers.
items.pairs: Used on: Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro (one per unit).

items.name: Split four-post holder
items.size_note: Two halves, each 163 × 58 × 30 mm; 320 mm long when joined
items.description: The four-post holder in two halves joined by a dovetail in the middle, for printers that can't fit the 320 mm one-piece holder. The studio uses it automatically on those printers.
items.pairs: Used on: Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro (one per unit), in place of the four-post holder.

items.name: AMS 2 Pro mounting template
items.description: Centers the four-post holder on a Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro: its three arms slot into the holder, and the notch on top fits the AMS 2 Pro's top latch.
items.pairs: Pairs with: one four-post holder per AMS 2 Pro.

items.name: AMS HT mounting template
items.description: Positions the one-post holder on a Bambu Lab AMS HT: the notch on top fits the top latch, and the opening positions the holder.
items.pairs: Pairs with: one one-post holder per AMS HT.

items.name: Creality SpacePi X4 mounting template
items.description: Fits the SpacePi X4 locking latch; each two-post holder sits on top of it, then the template slides down and off.
items.pairs: Pairs with: the two two-post holders each SpacePi X4 takes.
